threads.body: `circuitBreakerName` is an identifier recorded in the `failsafe.circuit_breaker.name` attribute, not a metric name. Both emitted metric names are fixed by the implementation. Describe this as the circuit-breaker name so users do not expect this argument to rename the metrics.

replies.body: Updated the Javadoc to say that the circuit breaker name is recorded in the `failsafe.circuit_breaker.name` metric attribute.

threads.body: `retryPolicyName` supplies the `failsafe.retry_policy.name` attribute; it does not control the fixed counter or histogram names. Describe it as the retry-policy name rather than a metric name to make the new API's configuration contract accurate.

replies.body: Updated the Javadoc to say that the retry policy name is recorded in the `failsafe.retry_policy.name` metric attribute.
